messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT: Observability - Datadog ingestion delay detected for runtime-prod. Metrics and logs delayed ~6-10m, alerts may be delayed. Paging eng-oncall. https://status.datadoghq.com :rotating_light:
lia: seeing blank panels on the runtime-prod dashboard. traces/logs also sparse. alerts for 5xx and qps didn't fire (suspect ingestion). :eyes:
dario: confirm. error-rate alert didn't page for a customer incident that started ~8m ago. pretty sure this is on the Datadog side (ingest lag pattern). can someone open a support case and post the ticket id?
morgan: mitigation ideas: 1) switch critical alerts to CloudWatch fallback for the next 30m, 2) enable short-term increased retention on our internal metric proxy, 3) re-run alert evaluation locally for the last 10m window.
kevin: i'll flip the fallback for the 5xx and latency alerts now. command i used: ```aws cloudwatch get-metric-statistics --namespace "Redwood/Runtime" --metric-name "5xxCount" --start-time $(date -u -d '10 minutes ago' +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:00Z) --end-time $(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:00Z) --period 60 --statistics Sum``` paste results if you need immediate numbers.
lia: thanks kevin. i'll notify the CSMs for affected customers (PayFlow, Chatly) and make a short incident note in the status channel.
eng-oncall-bot: @morgan you are now the primary on-call for this thread (handoff requested by lia). please ack.
morgan: acked. i'm on it. creating Datadog support case now, will paste case ID. also starting local eval of recent logs to confirm customer impact.
(datadog-bot): Datadog status page: https://status.datadoghq.com/incidents/abc123 - reported ingestion delay in us-east. updates incoming.
dario: note for triage: because Datadog is the single source for a lot of runtime signals, we have a blindspot for automated escalation. treat customer-facing pages as high risk until we confirm alerts triggered via fallback.
morgan: support case created: DD-7890123. escalated to L2. asking for ETA on reprocessing of delayed events. posted link in ticket.
kevin: applied CloudWatch fallback policy for routes/runtime/* alerts. temporary rule: route alerts to page channel + email. disabled noisy non-critical thresholds to reduce alert storm.
lia: CSMs notified, sent template message to affected customers: "We're currently observing an upstream Datadog ingestion delay affecting visibility. We're running fallbacks and monitoring — we'll update within 15m."
dario: checklist for now: 1) ensure fallback alerts are stable, 2) monitor for duplicate/resolved events once Datadog backfills, 3) hold off on any automated incident closures until we confirm reprocessing.
morgan: quick sanity: pulling recent error logs from S3 -> running a grep for 5xx counts. preliminary shows customer errors did occur but didn't page. pushing manual page to affected oncall for one customer while we wait for Datadog.
(datadog-bot): update from Datadog: "Ingestion delays continuing. Some metrics are delayed up to 15 minutes. Teams working on backfill."
kevin: note — when backfill happens we may see spikes in historical dashboards and alerts. we should mute auto-retries in our alerting pipeline for ~30m to avoid noisy reconcilers.
lia: agree. i'm adding a temporary suppression rule in the alerts dashboard. link to runbook I'm editing: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/datadog-ingest-delay
dario: if backfill causes a bunch of resolved alerts, make sure our incident automation doesn't auto-close customer tickets. leave manual closure.
morgan: L2 from Datadog just responded asking for org+source examples. shared windowed payload and a request id. they're prioritizing.
(datadog-bot): update: "Partial recovery observed in us-east. Ingestion latency decreasing to ~2-4m. Backfill in progress."
lia: i'm seeing some metrics return on the runtime-prod dashboards. still slightly delayed but trending better.
kevin: reverting temporary CloudWatch fallback in 20m unless we see more drift. leaving suppression rule for 30m to avoid thrash.
morgan: postmortem notes to capture: single-source observability blindspot, add cross-provider gating for critical alerts, improve runbook steps for paging during vendor outages, add automated fallback test.
dario: assign follow-ups: add item to oncall checklist to verify alternate alert pipeline during vendor incidents; assign to kevin. lia to coordinate customer comms follow-up. morgan to own post-incident writeup.
lia: thanks all. marking this thread as monitoring. will update if Datadog posts full resolution. if no further issues by +30m we can close. :thumbsup:
(datadog-bot): final update: "Incident resolved, ingestion returned to normal and backfill completed."
morgan: confirmed metrics/logs backfilled and alerts reconciled. no unexpected spikes after suppression lifted. closing incident; will start postmortem doc now and ping the postmortems channel.
lia: closing loop with customers and internal docs. good coordination — noted where runbook needed clearer fallback steps.
dario: nice work. add retention for fallback metrics test to quarterly reliability checklist.
kevin: done. created task RDW-4512 for automated fallback test.
lia: thread closed.
